text_block_list.name: Monologue
text_block_list.text:
Shinko Windy and I visit a shrine on<n>New Year's
Day.

text_block_list.name: Monologue
text_block_list.text: Once we finish praying, I turn to<n>Shinko Windy.
choice_data_list: Do you have any New Year's resolutions?

text_block_list.name: Shinko Windy
text_block_list.text: Of course I do! I'm gonna fulfill my<n>ambition!

text_block_list.name: Shinko Windy
text_block_list.text: Oh, and I'm gonna upgrade myreputation from plain ol' bad to thebig bad!

text_block_list.name: Monologue
text_block_list.text:
It's been almost a year since her<n>biting incident.
The dust is starting to<n>settle, and the event itself
seems to<n>be disappearing from collective<n>memory,
but...

text_block_list.name: Child A
text_block_list.text:
Ah! The naughty Umamusume who<n>bites! Did you
come to steal coins<n>from the shrine?!

text_block_list.name: Mother A
text_block_list.text:
Stop it! We don't talk about people<n>like that! I'm
terribly sorry. I'll give<n>him a strong talking-to later!

text_block_list.name: Monologue
text_block_list.text:
Her reputation remains unchanged.<n>She's still the
"biter" in the eyes of<n>the public.

text_block_list.name: Shinko Windy
text_block_list.text: Mrggghhh! I'm no stinky coin<n>snatcher!

It's all right, dearie. Plenty of folks<n>already know
that, trust me.

text_block_list.name: Wonder Acute
text_block_list.text:
Happy New Year. Heehee, I see<n>you're out visiting
a shrine as well.
choice_data_list:
A Happy New Year to you too. I hope you have a
good one.

text_block_list.name: Wonder Acute
text_block_list.text:
How nice of you to say. Do be careful<n>not to catch a
cold. Stuffy noses are<n>no fun at all.

text_block_list.name: Wonder Acute
text_block_list.text:
And you know, it's just marvelous<n>what the two of
you have<n>accomplished this past year. All us<n>dirt
runners have taken notice.

text_block_list.name: Shinko Windy
text_block_list.text:
Yeah, whatever. You're just buttering<n>me up,
yeah?

text_block_list.name: Wonder Acute
text_block_list.text: Oh dear me, I would never.

text_block_list.name: Wonder Acute
text_block_list.text:
...Here, Windy. Help yourself to some<n>crunchy
munchies and relax a<n>moment. There's some really
crunchy ones, I'll have you know.

text_block_list.name: Shinko Windy
text_block_list.text: ...Mnph!

text_block_list.name: Shinko Windy
text_block_list.text:
F-fine then. I'll take some off your<n>hands. Was
fiending to crush<n>something between my teeth
anyway.

text_block_list.name: Monologue
text_block_list.text:
Shinko Windy devours one pickled<n>veggie after
another, along with some<n>grilled corn from a nearby
food stall<n>for good measure. Thanks to that, it
seems like she's in a better mood<n>now.

text_block_list.name: Shinko Windy
text_block_list.text: Whew! That's good stuff!

text_block_list.name: Wonder Acute
text_block_list.text: Yes, yes, dearie. Glad you're back to<n>your old self.

text_block_list.name: Shinko Windy
text_block_list.text:
Heck yeah! Sometimes, I just gotta<n>munch on
something to clear my<n>head! Now I feel like I can
enjoy the<n>holiday!

text_block_list.name: Shinko Windy
text_block_list.text: All right! Take me somewhere fun,<n>Trainer!

text_block_list.name: Shinko Windy
text_block_list.text:
Bwahaha! Ya know what, Acute? You<n>come along
too. Trainer'll treat ya!

text_block_list.name: Wonder Acute
text_block_list.text:
Oh my, how sweet of you to consider<n>me. But it's
so out of the blue... I do<n>hope I won't be a bother.
choice_data_list:
Not at all. Think of it as a thank-you for the pickled
vegetables.

text_block_list.name: Monologue
text_block_list.text:
It's the least I could do for her help in<n>getting
Shinko Windy out of the<n>doldrums.

text_block_list.name: Wonder Acute
text_block_list.text: Are you sure? Then I'll take you up<n>on the offer.

text_block_list.name: Shinko Windy
text_block_list.text: Sweet! My trusty lackey doesn't<n>disappoint!

text_block_list.name: Shinko Windy
text_block_list.text: So? Where're we headed?
choice_data_list: Up for a trip to the beach?

text_block_list.name: Shinko Windy
text_block_list.text:
I like the sound of that! My belly's<n>still got plenty of
room left for treats!

text_block_list.name: Smart Falcon
text_block_list.text: Huh? Oh! It's Windy and Acute! ♪

text_block_list.name: Smart Falcon
text_block_list.text:
Happy New Year! ☆ I don't think I've<n>ever seen the
two of you in a shop<n>like this!

text_block_list.name: Shinko Windy
text_block_list.text: Oh! Falcon! Happy New Year. Lookslike you've got something real tastythere. Drool...

text_block_list.name: Shinko Windy
text_block_list.text:
I want one too! Ummm, I don't see it<n>on the
menu—oh, is this the same<n>thing?

text_block_list.name: Wonder Acute
text_block_list.text:
Which one, dearie? Bunny's<n>Strawberry Caramel
Cheese...<n>F...Frooo...

text_block_list.name: Shinko Windy
text_block_list.text: What kinda spell are you castin'?!

text_block_list.name: Smart Falcon
text_block_list.text:
That's "Bunny's Strawberry<n>Caramel Cheese
Fromage"! Ehehe!<n>I'll order one for you! ♪

text_block_list.name: Smart Falcon
text_block_list.text:
And for Acute... I recommend a<n>classic—dense and
moist rum cake! ♪

text_block_list.name: Wonder Acute
text_block_list.text: Oh my. It looks so scrumptious.

text_block_list.name: Smart Falcon
text_block_list.text:
Hehe! ♪ Yaaay! ☆ Why don't the<n>three of you sit
down with me?

text_block_list.name: Smart Falcon
text_block_list.text:
Actually, I've been wanting to chat<n>with you,
Windy! You were so cool in<n>that last race.

text_block_list.name: Smart Falcon
text_block_list.text:
...I know lots happened, but there's<n>something
about how you run. I can<n>really tell you're working
your tail off<n>every day.

text_block_list.name: Wonder Acute
text_block_list.text:
Heehee, didn't I tell you? All us dirt<n>runners are
taking notice.

text_block_list.name: Monologue
text_block_list.text:
Shinko Windy looks embarrassed but<n>happy as
well. The conversation<n>picks up from there and
everyone<n>has a great time.

text_block_list.name: Shinko Windy
text_block_list.text: Now that sounds fun! C'mon, let's<n>go!

text_block_list.name: Monologue
text_block_list.text:
We arrive at a nature park with a ton<n>of extra
attractions. Once the<n>admission fee is paid, we step
inside<n>and...

text_block_list.name: Copano Rickey
text_block_list.text:
Ahhh... The qi sure is flowing nicely! ♪<n>It must be
coming from the positive<n>energy of all these kids
playing in the<n>park.

text_block_list.name: Shinko Windy
text_block_list.text: Rickey! You're out for some fun too?

text_block_list.name: Copano Rickey
text_block_list.text: Oh! Happy New Year! ☆ What a nice<n>coincidence!

text_block_list.name: Copano Rickey
text_block_list.text:
Or should I say... my lucky direction<n>was spot-on?
After all, it led me to the<n>person I most wanted to
meet right<n>now. ♪

text_block_list.name: Shinko Windy
text_block_list.text: Mrgh? What do you mean?

text_block_list.name: Copano Rickey
text_block_list.text:
Hehe! ♪ I've been following your<n>progress since
last year, Windy!

text_block_list.name: Copano Rickey
text_block_list.text:
At times lashing out due to your<n>overbearing yang,
at others being<n>swallowed up by a powerful surge
of<n>yin, you went through some troubled<n>phases for
sure...

text_block_list.name: Copano Rickey
text_block_list.text:
But recently, I can tell you've found a<n>good
balance. How else could your<n>skin look so healthy
and your tail<n>glisten with that brilliant sheen?! ♪

text_block_list.name: Copano Rickey
text_block_list.text:
I can see you growing even stronger<n>from here on
out. That's why I've<n>become drawn to you!

text_block_list.name: Shinko Windy
text_block_list.text: Oh? I'mma get stronger, eh?

text_block_list.name: Shinko Windy
text_block_list.text:
I dunno much about feng shui, but I<n>can tell you've
got a good eye! ♪

text_block_list.name: Copano Rickey
text_block_list.text:
Hey! How about a game of tag? It'll<n>be a fun and
casual test of our skills!<n>☆

text_block_list.name: Shinko Windy
text_block_list.text: Now that's what I'm talkin' about!I'mma pounce on ya so fast thatyou'll run home crying!

text_block_list.name: Wonder Acute
text_block_list.text:
As I said, we dirt athletes have taken<n>notice of her...
Hehe, I think I'll join<n>them for a spell. ♪

text_block_list.name: Monologue
text_block_list.text:
Shinko Windy chases the two of them<n>around the
park. Looks like they're<n>getting some training and
fun in at the<n>same time!

text_block_list.name: Shinko Windy
text_block_list.text:
The beach on New Year's! Toughin'<n>out the cold
waves sounds<n>awesome!

text_block_list.name: Monologue
text_block_list.text:
A crowd of people has gathered<n>around a small
shop on the beach.<n>We go closer and find...

text_block_list.name: Hokko Tarumae
text_block_list.text:
Happy New Year, everyone! ♪ I'm<n>Hokko Tarumae!
♪ The surf clam<n>lov'n local idol from Tomakomai! ☆

text_block_list.name: Hokko Tarumae
text_block_list.text:
From the big blue right to you, I've<n>got a bunch of
tasty treats straight<n>from Tomakomai! Mmm! ♪
Doesn't<n>everyth'n look delish? Don't miss<n>out! ☆

text_block_list.name: Shinko Windy
text_block_list.text: Tarumae! You're working on New<n>Year's?!

text_block_list.name: Hokko Tarumae
text_block_list.text:
Huh? Oh, hi there, Windy, everybody!<n>I'm
volunteering, to tell the truth. The<n>fishermen from
back home asked me<n>for a favor.

text_block_list.name: Wonder Acute
text_block_list.text:
Oh my, how scrumptious looking.<n>Perhaps I should
purchase a thing or<n>two.

text_block_list.name: Hokko Tarumae
text_block_list.text:
By all means! And take your time.<n>We've put a
New Year's discount on<n>all the products!

text_block_list.name: Hokko Tarumae
text_block_list.text:
If memory serves, you like snacks<n>you can really
sink your teeth into,<n>right, Windy? What do you
think of<n>these dried surf clams?

text_block_list.name: Shinko Windy
text_block_list.text: Whoa! How'd you know that?

text_block_list.name: Shinko Windy
text_block_list.text: Spill it! What else do you know about<n>me?!

text_block_list.name: Hokko Tarumae
text_block_list.text:
Huh? ...What else? Well, I know about<n>your running
style and where you<n>placed in your last race. Is that
what<n>you're asking for?

text_block_list.name: Hokko Tarumae
text_block_list.text:
I do keep a close eye on other dirt<n>runners. So, yes,
I do know quite a bit.

text_block_list.name: Shinko Windy
text_block_list.text:
Heh-heh-heh! ♪ You've been<n>watchin' real close,
eh? Heehee!

text_block_list.name: Wonder Acute
text_block_list.text: Windy really does love being the<n>center of attention.

text_block_list.name: Hokko Tarumae
text_block_list.text: Hehe... I guess she does.

text_block_list.name: Shinko Windy
text_block_list.text:
Hehehe! ♪ Weeeheehee! ♪ Watch out,<n>next race!
I'm comin' for ya at full<n>speed!

text_block_list.name: Monologue
text_block_list.text:
Shinko Windy is in a fantastic mood.<n>We buy some
dried surf clams and<n>head on home.
